integrity: The complete mathematical argument and finite regression checker are present. Originality conclusions are based on source comparison rather than a claim of exhaustive search.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the standard L1 crosspolytope and \(2d+3\) nonrotated positive homothets in \(d\ge6\). The dimension-uniform lower bound uses a published Hamming graph chromatic theorem. The 2026 related covering-functional article was available only as an abstract; residual bibliographic uncertainty remains.
title: A four-color obstruction resolves the crosspolytope three-extra-copy conjecture
